metadata.study_name: Phase 22 H1 — Precision-Weighted & Directional Measurement Architecture Research

rq1_representations.name: Canonical Scalar Surprise
rq1_representations.component_preservation: None (collapses 3 axes into single Euclidean distance)
rq1_representations.prediction_error_semantics: Degenerates to state displacement ||p_T - p_0||_2 under unadapted beliefs
rq1_representations.baseline_dependence: High: anchored to baseline resting attractor p_0
rq1_representations.interpretability: Low: conflates orthogonal emotional trajectories (joy vs panic)

rq1_representations.name: Raw PAD Displacement Vector
rq1_representations.formula: Delta_p = p_T - p_0 = [Delta P, Delta A, Delta D]
rq1_representations.prediction_error_semantics: None (pure state displacement; do NOT call prediction error)
rq1_representations.baseline_dependence: High: explicitly computed relative to p_0
rq1_representations.interpretability: High: direct psychological mapping to PAD emotional space

rq1_representations.name: Displacement Magnitude + Direction
rq1_representations.dimension: scalar magnitude + 3-component unit direction (4 elements, 3 effective DOF)
rq1_representations.prediction_error_semantics: None (pure state displacement in polar coordinates)
rq1_representations.interpretability: High: intuitively separates affective intensity (m) from affective quality (v)

rq1_representations.name: Residual Magnitude + Direction
rq1_representations.dimension: scalar magnitude + 3-component unit direction (4 elements, 3 effective DOF)
rq1_representations.sign_polarity_preservation: Complete (carried by unit residual direction v_r)
rq1_representations.prediction_error_semantics: Complete: captures magnitude and orientation of model expectation failure
rq1_representations.transition_model_dependence: High: depends directly on learned transition model (A, b)
rq1_representations.interpretability: High: separates epistemic surprise magnitude from semantic orientation

rq1_representations.name: Full Vector Prediction Residual
rq1_representations.prediction_error_semantics: Complete Active Inference prediction error (no scalarization)
rq1_representations.transition_model_dependence: High: directly computed from generative expectation
rq1_representations.interpretability: High for Active Inference diagnostics (component surprise)

rq1_representations.name: Precision-Weighted Vector Residual
rq1_representations.component_preservation: Weighted composite (reweights axes before summing squares)
rq1_representations.angular_information: Ellipsoidal (direction modulates scalar via Pi geometry)
rq1_representations.baseline_dependence: Conditioned on expectation and metric tensor Pi
rq1_representations.transition_model_dependence: High: depends on generative prediction and precision matrix Pi
rq1_representations.interpretability: Moderate: single scalar metric, but geometry reflects metric tensor
rq1_representations.computational_cost: O(1): ~0.3 us (matrix-vector multiplication + dot product + sqrt)

Pi_0_identity.name: Pi_0: Isotropic Identity Matrix
Pi_0_identity.rationale: Degenerates mathematically to canonical scalar S = ||r_T||_2.

Pi_1_arousal_exploratory.name: Pi_1: Somatic/Arousal Prioritization
Pi_1_arousal_exploratory.rationale: Explores hypothetical 2:1 precision ratio on the somatic activation axis.
Pi_1_arousal_exploratory.guardrail_note: Unvalidated exploratory theoretical candidate. Any empirical separation under Pi_1 is strictly reported as a mathematical property of this formula, and must NOT be claimed as evidence for higher physiological importance of Arousal in Lucia.

Pi_2_geometric_headroom.name: Pi_2: Philia Headroom Normalization
Pi_2_geometric_headroom.classification: Fixed geometric normalization metric / exploratory precision candidate
Pi_2_geometric_headroom.rationale: Inverse square of distance from Philia resting attractor to [-1, 1] bounds (h_i^-2).
Pi_2_geometric_headroom.guardrail_note: Valid geometric distance-to-boundary normalization, but NOT automatically biological precision in the Active Inference sense. Must not be conflated with a validated biological precision model.

Pi_3_mt_lnn_coupled.name: Pi_3: Coupled Limbic Interaction Metric
Pi_3_mt_lnn_coupled.rationale: Off-diagonal Valence-Arousal cross-coupling (rho_PA = -0.3) reflecting MT-LNN limbic ODE dynamics.
Pi_3_mt_lnn_coupled.guardrail_note: Positive definite metric tensor with eigenvalues 1.3, 0.7, 1.0; explores limbic cross-drag.

form_1_dynamic_precision.description: Dynamic precision matrix modulation conditioned on metabolic energy / fatigue state
form_1_dynamic_precision.theoretical_appeal: High: matches Active Inference biological principle that high metabolic fatigue attenuates sensory precision
form_1_dynamic_precision.lucia_architectural_hook: EmotionCore maintains physiological energy E in [0, 1] and fatigue, but ActiveInferenceEngine operates on state uncoupled from energy

form_2_effective_surprise.description: Post-hoc modulation of surprise magnitude or vector by metabolic gating factors (e.g. beta_epist(E, C))
form_2_effective_surprise.theoretical_appeal: Moderate: preserves underlying measurement while scaling behavioral downstream impact
form_2_effective_surprise.lucia_architectural_hook: Already present in ActionSelectionEngine where beta_epist(E, C) modulates epistemic foraging bonus

evidence_inventory.emotion_core_energy_decay: Validated in Phase 21: EmotionCore integrates metabolic consumption during arousal spikes and recovers during rest
evidence_inventory.active_inference_coupling: Currently decoupled: ActiveInferenceEngine.step() consumes only PADState, with 0 homeostatic inputs
evidence_inventory.action_selection_homeostatic_gating: Validated in Phase 22 H1: beta_epist(E, C) attenuates information gain under low energy, preventing epistemic exploration when depleted

rq6_homeostatic_relevance.conceptual_status_classification: B — Plausible future research direction, but currently unsupported by validated production evidence
rq6_homeostatic_relevance.classification_rationale: While homeostatic state (energy, fatigue) is validated in Lucia's EmotionCore and modulates action selection policy, coupling homeostatic state directly into measurement precision Pi is currently unsupported by existing empirical evidence. Any formulation of Pi = f(homeostatic_state) remains an exploratory hypothesis for future research.
rq6_homeostatic_relevance.guardrail_compliance: Verified: No parameter fitting performed; no claims of biological validation made.

M0_canonical_scalar.conversational_viability: M0 does not satisfy the current preregistered dual Gate 2 thresholds at T <= 25 under frozen G1/current dynamics (Delta_HM remains compressed <= 0.107 across all conversational exposures)
M0_canonical_scalar.mechanism: Radial Euclidean projection collapses orthogonal trajectories into similar scalar distances from p0.

M1_displacement_vector.conversational_viability: HIGHLY VIABLE across all T in {1, 2, 4, 8, 12, 16, 25} (Arousal Cohen's d > 9.0, Pleasure d ~ -0.94)

M2_magnitude_direction.conversational_viability: HIGHLY VIABLE: angular separation reaches 66.1 deg by T=2 and stays stable across conversational exposures
M2_magnitude_direction.mechanism: Directional unit vector preserves affective quality even when scalar magnitude is compressed.

M3_residual_magnitude_direction.conversational_viability: HIGHLY VIABLE: mirrors M2 under unadapted prior, preserves epistemic violation orientation under adapted prior
M3_residual_magnitude_direction.mechanism: Unit residual vector captures epistemic expectation violation orientation.

M4_full_residual_vector.conversational_viability: HIGHLY VIABLE: full 3D prediction residual retains component-specific surprise
M4_full_residual_vector.mechanism: Preserves Active Inference prediction error without projection loss.

M5_precision_weighted_scalar.Pi_0_identity: Identical to M0; fails Gate 2 at all T <= 25
M5_precision_weighted_scalar.Pi_1_arousal_exploratory: Passes dual Gate 2 at T >= 8 (Delta_ML=0.22, Delta_HM=0.55 at T=12) due to selective amplification of Arousal, but collapses Pleasure and represents an unvalidated theoretical formula
M5_precision_weighted_scalar.Pi_2_geometric_headroom: Fails Gate 2 at T <= 25 (Delta_HM=0.106 at T=12); geometric headroom weighting does not resolve orthogonal collapse
M5_precision_weighted_scalar.Pi_3_mt_lnn_coupled: Fails Gate 2 at T <= 25 (Delta_HM=0.098 at T=12); off-diagonal drag does not overcome radial collapse

physiological_surprise.definition: What happened differs from what the current generative model predicted (prediction residual r_T != 0)
physiological_surprise.representation_requirements: Requires retaining prediction residual r_T = p_hat_T - p_T. Scalar reduction S = ||r_T|| collapses orientation, whereas vector residual preserves component-specific expectation failure.
physiological_surprise.cognitive_role: Triggers immediate somatic modulation, arousal spike, and Free Energy model parameter updates.

epistemic_uncertainty.definition: The system does not sufficiently know what state/action/outcome is relevant (entropy H(P) or H_Ecphory)
epistemic_uncertainty.representation_requirements: Evaluated across probability distributions over discrete beliefs or memory competing attractors. Independent of emotional state magnitude.
epistemic_uncertainty.cognitive_role: Governs exploratory epistemic foraging policy (seeking clarifying actions to reduce entropy).

impact_of_measurement_architecture.scalar_conflation_risk: When surprise is measured as scalar S, orthogonal physiological events (e.g. a high-arousal crisis vs a high-valence success) produce identical surprise magnitudes. If downstream cognitive routing conditions on S alone, the system cannot distinguish whether uncertainty requires somatic stabilization (calming arousal) or epistemic inquiry (clarification).
impact_of_measurement_architecture.vector_residual_benefit: Retaining vector residual r_T provides downstream routing with both the magnitude (urgency) and the affective orientation (component polarity) of expectation failure, allowing clean decoupling between physiological adjustment and epistemic foraging.

final_synthesis.final_state: State B — Direction/Component Information Demonstrably Omitted Under Scalar S
final_synthesis.rationale: Scalar S demonstrably omits directional/component information; whether that omission is architecturally unacceptable remains unresolved. Empirical evidence across T <= 25 demonstrates that canonical scalar S collapses orthogonal emotional trajectories into identical scalar distances (|diff_S| <= 0.02). Magnitude-matched analysis (RQ4) confirms evidence consistent with directional/component information persisting after magnitude matching (61-104 deg separation). Furthermore, while predefined exploratory precision weighting (Pi_1) can numerically separate tiers by prioritizing Arousal, it does so as an unvalidated exploratory candidate that discards Pleasure, whereas geometrically grounded normalization (Pi_2) and coupled metric (Pi_3) fail to resolve collapse. Vector representations (M1-M4) preserve complete information across all conversational exposures (T >= 1), but promoting them requires an explicit Architecture Gate decision, which remains strictly locked.
